answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable work bond that vests only after sustained, independently verified service. A newcomer starts at the tundra edge of trust, earning credit a yarrow at a time for tasks checked by random established peers, and only reaches the zenith of full voting weight after months of clean history. Creating thousands of fake identities then means funding thousands of bonds and months of real work each, while one detected duplicate forfeits the whole bond, so sybil farming costs more than it can ever earn.
